name: Bulgarian Sign Language
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Sign language; Glottolog bulg1240 lists only lexical-comparison/history refs (Bickford 2005; Woll et al. 2001; Rutkowski & Sak 2016); no word-stress description applicable/located.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3, languoid bulg1240 (refs: Bickford 2005; Woll, Sutton-Spence & Elton 2001; Rutkowski & Sak 2016; Eberhard et al. 2025)
sources.note: Only classification/history references; no descriptive (grammar/phonology) reference listed.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Bulgarian Sign Language'; Wikipedia (bg) 'Български жестомимичен език' (wikitext saved)
sources.note: Classification (Wittmann 1991; Bickford 2005), dictionaries (1961, 1996, 2009) and news links only; nothing structural.

sources.citation: Lozanova, Slavina. 2026. Българският жестов език като втори език: анализ на езиковата сложност и особености при изучаването му. Pedagogika-Pedagogy 98(4s): 79-96. doi:10.53656/ped2026-4s.05
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. pp. 81-82: reports that 2017-2023 MON project issued the dictionary and 'три монографии с описание на граматиката на езика (Tisheva et al., 2017; Tisheva et al., 2023а, 2023b)' and that BZhE shows 'визуална фонология', iconicity, agglutinative morphology, non-manual grammatical markers. p. 93 gives full records with ISBNs of the three grammar volumes.

sources.citation: Dacheva, Gergana. 2025. Семиотичната същност на жестовия език. Български език и литература 67(3): 345-351. doi:10.53656/bel2025-3-5D
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Semiotic classification of signs (Peirce); nothing on phonology, prosody or stress; no BZhE-specific references.

sources.citation: Georgieva, Diyana. 2025. Signmatics: An Interactive Digital Based System for Multimodal Learning of Hearing Students in Bulgarian Sign Language. IJCRSEE 13(1): 117-125.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Pedagogical experiment; 'phonology' used for sign parameters (handshape etc.) in a test battery; nothing on stress or prosody.

sources.citation: Lozanova, Slavina & Ivelina Stoyanova. 2022. WordNet-Based Bulgarian Sign Language Dictionary of Crisis Management Terminology. Proceedings of CLIB 2022, 59-67.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress; notes 'there are no available electronic and computationally processable resources for Bulgarian sign language'; gives mon.bg URL of the 2017 dictionary (https://mon.bg/upload/21132/Rechnik_bg_zhestov_ezik.pdf).

sources.citation: Deaf Studies Institute. 2021. Методика за оценка на езиковата компетентност на български жестов език. Sofia (Product A3, 8 pp.).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Assessment methodology; nothing on stress, prosody, rhythm or intonation.

sources.citation: Lozanova, Slavina. 2018. Issues in Bulgarian Sign Language Interpreting. English Studies at NBU 4(2): 131-144. doi:10.33919/esnbu.18.2.4
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. p. 134: 'not much linguistic work has been done on Bulgarian sign language'; BGSL 'an independent language with its own grammatical and semantic structure' citing Ministry of Education and Science 2017a (Teoretichno opisanie na gramatikata na bulgarskiya zhestov ezik).

sources.citation: Tisheva, Yovka; Hristova, Valentina; Zhobov, Vladimir; Dacheva, Gergana; Aleksova, Krasimira; Angelkova, Petya; Popzlateva, Tsanka; Stoyanova, Yuliana. 2017. Речник на българския жестов език [Dictionary of the Bulgarian Sign Language]. Sofia: Ministry of Education and Science / Nauka i obrazovanie (project BG05M2OP001-3.003-0001), 854 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Introduction (Popzlateva, pp. VII-XVII, section 'Научно изследване на структурния състав на лексикалния жестов знак') describes sign-internal structure only as handshape (dez), location (tab), movement (sig), palm/finger orientation (ori) and hand arrangement (ha), adapted from the 1992 BSL Dictionary; no mention of stress, prosody, rhythm or intonation anywhere in the front matter (a full-text search for stress/accent ударение/просодия/интонация/ритъм: no hits).

sources.citation: Tisheva, Yovka; Dacheva, Gergana; Aleksova, Krasimira. 2023. Описание на граматиката на българския жестов език. Трета част. Sofia: MON. ISBN 978-954-8973-39-7.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Second part of the MON grammar description; may extend to prosody/non-manual marking.

sources.citation: Tisheva, Yovka; Dacheva, Gergana; Aleksova, Krasimira; Stoyanova, Yuliana; Zhobov, Vladimir. 2017. Теоретично описание на граматиката на българския жестов език. Sofia: Ministry of Education and Science (project BG05M2OP001-3.003-0001).
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: First monograph-length grammatical description of BZhE (companion to the 2017 dictionary); the only place a phonology/prosody chapter (and any remark on sign prominence) is likely to exist. Zhobov is a phonetician.

sources.citation: Lozanova, Slavina & Ivelina Stoyanova. 2015. Интеркултурни и социолингвистични особености на жестовия език в България. Languages and Literature. Research Papers 53(1): 290-302.

sources.note: Sociolinguistic overview of BZhE by the main researchers; low chance of a stress statement.

sources.citation: Lozanova, Slavina. 2015. Семиотични аспекти на вербално-жестовия билингвизъм при деца с увреден слух. PhD dissertation, New Bulgarian University, Sofia.
